title: 第9章 开始炼丹第10章 极品回春丹
slug: 为了长生不死我带着全宗修仙
content_zh:
;;
修炼也并不是随便找个地方坐下就行。
不然那些修士那么费尽心思布置自己的洞府做什么？
这边的灵气稀薄，能够在这么短时间内成功引气入体，也是因为叶无忧的天赋高。
如果是换作其他人，至少也得花费一个月的时间。
现在情况就是，门找到了，钥匙也找到了，但是进不去屋。
拥有足够的力气（灵气）之后，才能把门推开。
寂月闻言，对此其实也没有什么头绪。
她是五行混沌灵根，不需要过多纠结这周围是什么灵气，因为进入她体内之后，它们会自行转化为她需要的。
但叶无忧只是一条极品雷系灵根，而雷灵根是极为稀缺的，修炼起来也比普通人艰难些。
得去雷灵气充足的地方，这样修炼才能事半功倍。
“不着急，此地灵气稀薄，你能在这么短时间内成功引气入体，已是不易。待离开此处，去到灵气更充足的地方，对你的修炼更有益处。”寂月一本正经地说。
要说什么修炼，她其实就是个半吊子。
要不是有系统这个外挂，加上那一年后任务不完成就抹杀的大刀，她其实更愿意找个灵气充足的山沟沟，苟到渡劫期，然后再悄咪咪飞升。
说多了都是泪啊。
叶无忧也没有多纠结，只要能修炼，那一切都是好的。
寂琳走过去，接过了生火做饭的担子，把一切都打理的井井有条。
寂月只需要在一旁看着。
倒不是她不想帮忙，实在是这一个月以来，都是这么干的。
痴傻了十六年的大姐，突然就脑子灵光起来，要不是这一家子都是普通人，只怕是要联想到夺舍去。

寂琳习惯了照顾大姐的日子，再加上她是因为大姐才有机会修仙的，所以她也愿意做这些琐碎的事。
而落在叶无忧的眼里，那就是另一回事了。
师父果然是不出世的大能，估计以前都是一门心思扑到修炼上，所以才把这些琐事都交给大师姐。
“师姐，我来帮你。”眼睁睁地看着一个六岁小孩做饭，她还是做不到的。
师父跟着她们一起吃饭，这叫什么？
这叫平易近人，这叫与民同乐！
一个星期后，三人终于抵达了附近的一座城池。
叶家不在此地，她们三人是朝着另一个方向走的。
要问为什么，寂月只回答两个字，直觉！
在城中购买了衣物以及炼丹炉之后，她们找了一家客栈住下。
城里的灵气比外面要充足一些，特别适合筑基期以下的修士。
叶无忧和寂琳一个房间，交代她们自己安生修炼之后，寂月便回到了自己的屋子。
她要炼丹。
系统商城不知道什么时候才能打开，所以她只能靠自己的能力。
手里头的灵石不剩多少，她要是再不去挣，那她们师徒三人就只能喝西北风了。
炼丹炉她一口气买了十个，因为炼丹师经常炸炉的原因，她也不敢赌自己能一次性成功。
所以多买几个，就当是保险。
把之前收集的药材一点一点地拿出来，随后按照脑子里给的丹方，一点一点非常细致地处理药材。
如果寂月能弄到其他人手里的丹方，只怕是要惊一惊。
正常炼丹师手里的丹方可没有那么多的注意事项，丹方只有所需药材，至于药材怎么处理，得靠他们自行体会。

这就是顶级丹方的区别，也是系统的牛逼之处！
全神贯注，小心翼翼，眼睛一眨也不眨的盯着炼丹炉。
content_en:
;;
Cultivation is not just about finding a place to sit down.
Otherwise, why would those monks put so much effort into decorating their caves?
The spiritual energy here is thin, and the reason why he can successfully introduce it into his body in such a short period of time is because of Ye Wuyou's high talent.
If it were anyone else, it would have taken at least a month.
The current situation is that I found the door and the key, but I can't get into the house.
Only when you have enough strength (spiritual energy) can you push the door open.
Hearing this, Jiyue actually had no clue about this.
She has the five elements of chaotic spiritual roots, so she doesn't need to worry too much about what spiritual energy is around her, because after entering her body, they will automatically transform into what she needs.
But Ye Wuyou only has a top-grade thunder spiritual root, and thunder spiritual roots are extremely rare, and their cultivation is more difficult than ordinary people.
You have to go to a place with sufficient thunder spirit energy, so that you can practice with twice the result with half the effort.
"Don't worry, the spiritual energy here is thin. It's not easy for you to successfully introduce the energy into your body in such a short period of time. Leaving here and going to a place with more spiritual energy will be more beneficial to your cultivation." Jiyue said seriously.
When it comes to cultivation, she is actually just a dabbler.
If it weren't for the system's plug-in, and the sword that would erase the mission if it wasn't completed one year later, she would actually prefer to find a mountain valley with enough spiritual energy to survive until the tribulation period, and then quietly ascend.
Talking too much brings tears to my eyes.
Ye Wuyou didn't worry too much. As long as he could practice, everything would be fine.
Ji Lin walked over, took over the burden of making fire and cooking, and took care of everything in order.
Jiyue just needs to watch from the sidelines.
It's not that she doesn't want to help. In fact, she has been doing this for the past month.
The eldest sister, who had been stupid for sixteen years, suddenly had a bright idea. If this family were not all ordinary people, she would have thought of taking away the body.
Ji Lin was used to taking care of her eldest sister, and it was because of her eldest sister that she had the opportunity to become an immortal, so she was willing to do these trivial things.
But in Ye Wuyou's eyes, it was another matter.
The master is indeed an unborn almighty. He probably used to focus solely on cultivation, so he left all these trivial matters to the senior sister.
"Senior sister, let me help you." Watching a six-year-old child cooking, she still couldn't do it.
The master eats with them. What is this called?
This is called being approachable and having fun with the people!
A week later, the three finally arrived at a nearby city.
The Ye family is not here, the three of them are walking in another direction.
When asked why, Jiyue could only answer with two words: intuition!
After buying clothes and an alchemy furnace in the city, they found an inn to stay.
The spiritual energy in the city is more abundant than outside, which is especially suitable for monks below the foundation building stage.
Ye Wuyou and Ji Lin were in the same room. After telling them to cultivate in peace, Ji Yue returned to her room.
She wants to make an elixir.
She didn't know when the system mall would be opened, so she could only rely on her own abilities.
There are not many spirit stones left in her hand. If she doesn't earn it, the three of them, master and disciple, will have no choice but to drink from the northwest wind.
She bought ten alchemy furnaces at once. Because alchemists often exploded the furnaces, she did not dare to bet that she could succeed in one go.
So buy a few more and treat them as insurance.
Take out the medicinal materials collected earlier bit by bit, and then process the medicinal materials very carefully bit by bit according to the prescription in your mind.
If Jiyue could get the pill formula in the hands of others, she would be shocked.
Normal alchemists don't have that many precautions for the elixir in their hands. The elixir only has the required medicinal materials. As for how to handle the medicinal materials, they have to rely on their own experience.
This is the difference between the top elixirs and the awesomeness of the system!
Pay full attention, be careful, and stare without blinking.Holding an alchemy furnace.
